title: SPARC Cat - Sham Control Chronic Cat 3, Day 0
author: Brett Hanzlicek
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bfzdjp26
materials: Transport cat from housing site to surgery site.
Empty Bladder Cat transitioned back to isoflurane

steps.title: Prepare Animal for Surgery
steps.instruction: Anesthetize the cat, shave the abdomen, and move the animal to the surgery room for monitoring.

substeps.instruction: Anesthetize animal and shave abdomen
Attach animal to monitors in the surgery room
Drape animal and perform betadine scrub on abdomen and genitals

steps.title: Insert Bladder Catheter
steps.instruction: Insert a 3.5Fr catheter into the bladder via the urethra using surgilube.

substeps.instruction: Apply surgilube to 3.5Fr catheter
Insert catheter into bladder through the urethra
Advance catheter until resistance is met, then pull back 2-3cm

steps.title: Collect Urine and Visualize Bladder
steps.instruction: Withdraw urine for analysis and use contrast to visualize the bladder via CT.

substeps.instruction: Use gentle suction with a syringe to withdraw urine from the bladder
Measure volume and save urine for urinalysis
Use a 1:5 dilution of contrast to saline to visualize bladder
Take a 3D CT image with 30ml contrast:saline in the bladder

steps.title: Perform Initial Pressure Recording
steps.instruction: Record bladder pressure using a syringe pump and pressure transducer after transferring the cat from Isoflurane to propofol anesthetic.

substeps.instruction: Transfer cat from Isoflurane to propofol anesthetic
Set fill rate to 2ml saline/minute using a syringe pump
Connect external pressure transducer to the syringe pump and tubing leading to the catheter
Fill bladder with saline and record pressure using Labview software

steps.title: Insert Device and Close Bladder
steps.instruction: Access the bladder and insert the device following the 'SPARC Cat surgery Day 0' protocol.

substeps.instruction: Access and open the bladder per 'SPARC Cat surgery Day 0' protocol
Place device in bladder
Suture bladder closed with 4-5 stitches
Add 25 ml of dilute contrast through the catheter
Check for leaks and place bladder back into body

steps.title: Verify Placement via Imaging
steps.instruction: Capture images of the device placement using DYNA-CT and 3D CT.

substeps.instruction: Take a picture with DYNA-CT
Take a 3D CT image

steps.title: Remove Device and Final Closure
steps.instruction: Remove the device and close the surgical sites.

substeps.instruction: Remove stitches from bladder
Remove device
Suture the bladder and abdomen per 'SPARC Cat surgery Day 0' protocol

steps.title: Perform Final Pressure Recording
steps.instruction: Conduct a final saline fill and pressure recording.

substeps.instruction: Fill bladder with saline at 2ml/min
Record pressure using pressure transducer connected to LabView

steps.title: Recovery
steps.instruction: Allow the cat to recover and return to housing.

substeps.instruction: Wait for cat to wake up
Return cat to housing site
